subject: DeltaHealth — critical path, handoff notes & steward nominations
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Samir Shah <samir@deltahealth.com>
Cc: Elena Martin <elena.m@deltahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: DeltaHealth — critical path, handoff notes & steward nominations

Team — quick handoff note for DeltaHealth (closed last week). I’m dropping MVP scope and the signed MSA in attachments. High-level context and asks below so CS can pick up with minimal back-and-forth.

Deal summary (short):
- Product: Redwood Hosted API + Dedicated (reserved capacity) for PHI workloads.
- Initial scope: embeddings for search, assistant chat with context, telemetry to Redshift.
- Committed throughput: 120 req/s (95th percentile peak), target latency 150–250ms token latency.
- Start of paid service window: target kickoff week of 11/29.

Critical risks to call out up-front:
1) SSO + SCIM (customer will enforce SAML 2.0 IdP) — they need SP metadata and a contact from our side to test.
2) Data residency: they require EU data at rest for backups (we will propose dedicated region routing).
3) Token budget: they intend to run long-context pipelines — we should align on model variant & quantization to hit cost targets.
4) Integrations: their integration partner (Orion Systems) will own the Health Data Ingest pipeline.

Immediate asks for CS (please action by EOD MON 11/23):
- Nominate primary CS steward + secondary (technical) owner.
- Confirm kickoff date window (they prefer 11/29–12/03).
- Confirm whether we can host their backups in eu-west-1 (legal has pre-approved if we apply region tag).
- Share list of evidence artifacts we need for their security/compliance (they asked for SOC2 attestations + logging retention details).

Attachments: DeltaHealth-MVP-scope.xlsx, Signed-MSA.pdf, SAML-SP-metadata.xml

Notes for assigned owner: I will remain involved through the first 30 days (scope questions, billing handoff). Key contacts: Samir Shah (Head of Platform) and Elena Martin (SRE) — Elena will coordinate the SAML test.

Next step: Karthik — can you propose a steward by EOD MON? Tessa/Marissa — flag any non-starter items. Samir — thanks again; I’ll let the CS team coordinate scheduling.

—
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Shah <samir@deltahealth.com>, Elena Martin <elena.m@deltahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: DeltaHealth — critical path, handoff notes & steward nominations

Thanks Jasmine — quick acknowledgement. I recommend Tessa as CS lead and Marissa as technical implementation owner (she’ll run the SAML/infra integration). Tessa, Marissa — are you both available for a 30–40m kickoff on Tue 11/30 10:00–10:40 PT or Wed 12/1 09:00–09:40 PT?

Preliminary internal plan (short):
- Week 0 (kickoff): align success criteria, confirm SAML test account, exchange onboarding tokens & IP allowlist.
- Week 1–2: SAML + network connectivity validation, ingest pipeline sandbox, model selection (dev vs. prod variants).
- Week 3–4: Load testing on Dedicated pool, telemetry setup, acceptance criteria run.

Risks I want to escalate to the team:
- If we need EU backups immediately, Dedicated capacity placement will require an ops ticket and potentially a 3–5 day provisioning delay.
- If Orion needs SSH access to staging, we must confirm our cross-org access policy.

I’ll stay on the thread for the initial two weeks.

-Karthik
Sr. Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Shah <samir@deltahealth.com>, Elena Martin <elena.m@deltahealth.com>, Orion Systems <ops@orionsys.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: DeltaHealth — critical path, handoff notes & steward nominations

Happy to take primary stewardship for DeltaHealth. Marissa will be technical owner for SAML, network, and performance testing. Proposed kickoff: Tue 11/30 10:00 PT — Samir/Elena, please confirm; if that doesn't work we can move to Wed 12/1 09:00 PT.

Initial implementation checklist (I’ll convert to a runbook after kickoff):
- Pre-kickoff (by kickoff): get SP metadata loaded in their IdP and confirm test user firing; exchange IP ranges for allowlist; share a short SOC2 evidence packet (I'll attach link after internal review).
- Day 0–7: validate SAML flows + SCIM provisioning (Marissa/Orion); stand up ingest sandbox with sample PII scrubbed set; verify token billing baseline.
- Day 8–21: run controlled load test at 50% expected throughput, tune batching/kv cache; recommend model variant (we'll test quantized 4-bit variant for cost).
- Acceptance gate: pass SAML, pass ingest verification, throughput within 20% of committed SLA on Dedicated pool.

Open asks to Jasmine/Karthik before kickoff:
1) Please confirm if the signed MSA includes the Dedicated region constraint for eu-west-1 (legal redline attached? Jasmine?)
2) Samir — provide the contact for the person who will approve network peering & firewall rules (we need an on-call SRE).
3) Can Orion share a brief diagram of their ingest pipeline and expected message size distribution?

I’ll prepare a short risk register to share at kickoff. Marissa — feel free to add any infra-specific items.

Thanks — looking forward to driving this.

—
Tessa Morgan
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwood.com | (650) 555-0124
From: Samir Shah <samir@deltahealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Martin <elena.m@deltahealth.com>, Orion Systems <ops@orionsys.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: DeltaHealth — critical path, handoff notes & steward nominations

Tessa — thanks and confirmed for Tue 11/30 10:00 PT. Elena will be on the call (SRE) and will own network approvals. Elena, looped above.

A few clarifications from our side:
- We asked legal for a minor redline on the MSA referencing EU backups. We can accept region tagging if you confirm backups will not leave eu-west-1.
- Orion — I asked you to include a small diagram (1 slide) that shows where Redwood sits and where they stage scrubbed messages.
- Ongoings: we have a 30-day pilot budget. Can you confirm who from Redwood will own pilot billing vs. post-pilot commercial provisioning?

Appreciate the clarity here — looking forward to kickoff.

Best,
Samir Shah
Head of Platform | DeltaHealth
samir@deltahealth.com | +1 212-555-0109
